text.offer: I am glad thou art here; I am willing to make a trade. I stumbled across a formula for speeding the growing process of certain plants, but it has fallen into the hands of the scoundrel Lady Aftyn. I will teach thee the small magicks I know if thou wilt but retrieve this formula for me. Ask her about the formula.
text.complete: Ah, at last. Thou hast done a great service not only to thyself but also to the entire realm. These plants may change the course of history. Come to me when thou would learn from me, friend.

steps.objective: Ask Lady Aftyn about the formula

steps.brief: I have the formula of which you speak. I am reluctant to give it to you, however, as I believe that Joguer's motives are not as noble as he claims. If you prove to me your strength of purpose by slaying a cave orc, however, I will defer to your judgement.
Very well, here is the formula. I am not happy to be giving you this. But that is not your concern really is it. You just want to get your spell and be off.
